skill.name: firebase-development
skill.description: Guides Firebase project setup, feature development, debugging, and validation with emulator-first workflows and security-focused review steps.
skill.summary: Route Firebase work through setup, feature, debugging, and validation workflows.
skill.author: 2389-research

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown code-fence false positives or localhost emulator references. I confirmed environment-file reads in debug/SKILL.md and found sensitive debug logging guidance. The skill should be revised before broad publication to prevent secret exposure during troubleshooting.

remediation.issue: Environment file reads in the debug workflow
remediation.suggestion: Remove commands that print .env files. Ask users for redacted variable names or sanitized configuration summaries instead.

remediation.issue: Debug guidance asks users to log API keys and request data
remediation.suggestion: Require redaction for API keys, tokens, request bodies, and stack traces before sharing logs.

remediation.issue: Forceful process termination appears in emulator troubleshooting
remediation.suggestion: Prefer graceful emulator shutdown and require user confirmation before killing any process by PID.

content.user_title: Build Firebase Projects With Safer Workflows
content.value_statement: Firebase work spans setup, functions, Firestore rules, emulators, and deployment checks. This skill provides routed workflows for setup, feature work, debugging, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Routes Firebase requests to setup, feature, debug, or validation workflows.
Guides Firebase initialization with hosting, auth, functions, and security model decisions.
Outlines TDD steps for Cloud Functions, API endpoints, and Firestore collections.
Provides emulator debugging steps for ports, rules, functions, auth, and deployment failures.
Reviews Firebase projects for rules, authentication, architecture, tests, and production readiness.
limitations: It provides instructions, not direct Firebase Console access.
It depends on local Firebase CLI, Node.js, and project permissions.
Some workflows ask for shell commands that require user review before execution.
It cannot verify deployed production resources without provided access or logs.

best_practices: Run emulator tests before deployment and keep test data separate from production.
Keep environment values redacted when sharing logs, prompts, or screenshots.
Prefer server-write-only Firestore rules unless client writes need strict validation.
anti_patterns: Do not paste unredacted environment files into an assistant or issue tracker.
Do not mix Firebase functions architecture patterns inside one project.
Do not mark work complete before build, test, lint, and emulator checks pass.

faq.question: What Firebase tasks does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers project setup, feature development, debugging, and validation for Firebase projects.

faq.question: Does it run Firebase commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides command guidance that users or agents should review before execution.

faq.question: Can it help with Firestore rules?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes rule design, rule validation, and Rules Playground debugging steps.

faq.question: Does it support emulator workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes local emulators for development, testing, and debugging.

faq.question: Can it review production readiness?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks configuration, authentication, rules, tests, builds, and deployment concerns.

faq.question: What should users redact before sharing logs?
faq.answer: Users should redact API keys, tokens, private identifiers, environment values, and request bodies.
